mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital flows into equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.15% yet 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates signal deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% yet 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and employment indicate weakening economic activity, triggering negative equity returns as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and PAYEMS < 140000 yet 20-day returns positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation as measured by 12-month CPI growth exceeding 2.5% prompts central bank rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 12m growth > 2.5% yet 60-day returns positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts signal increased consumer confidence and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as demand expands.
failure_condition: HOUST > 950 yet 5-day returns negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 102.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 102.0 yet 20-day returns negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in retail sales and inflation signals strong consumer spending power, leading to positive equity returns as corporate revenue expectations rise over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 435000 and CPIAUCSL 12m growth > 2.0% yet 20-day returns negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Subpar GDP growth below 0.5% annualized indicates economic weakness, reducing corporate profitability forecasts and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 3m growth < 0.5% yet 60-day returns positive in > 60% of instances.
